about.intro: Provodnik helps you plan a Stay Out run: it turns your quests into a route by location and NPC and builds one list of everything to bring.
about.dataSource: Quest, NPC, location and item data comes from the so-wiki.ru wiki and is licensed under CC BY 4.0. Every quest links to its source page.
about.dataHonesty: Some data (steps, step locations) is extracted from free text automatically and is marked as such. When something could not be determined, the app says so and suggests checking the wiki.
about.languageNote: Only the interface is translated. Quest, NPC and item names and wiki texts stay in Russian, as in the source.

data.sample: The catalog currently holds a sample of {{count}} quests; full data will come later.

quest.notFound: Quest not found in the data.
quest.hiddenNote: Hidden quest: it does not appear in the in-game journal.

prevLogic.unknown: The wiki does not say how the conditions combine (AND/OR).

quest.stepsParsed: Steps, locations and NPCs were extracted automatically — compare with the process text below.
quest.noSteps: Steps could not be extracted — see the process text below.
quest.perUnit: Rewards are per unit: the total depends on the quantity you are given.

error.title: Something went wrong
error.text: The page could not be shown. Your journal is saved — try reloading.
